field.label: Connection URL
field.helpText: Refer to the JDBC vendor's documentation for the connection URL syntax.

field.label: Class Name
field.helpText: Enter the fully-qualified Java class name of the JDBC driver, which you can get from the JDBC vendor's documentation. For example, sun.jdbc.odbc.JdbcOdbcDriver.

field.label: User Name
field.helpText: Enter the user name to log into the database.

field.label: Password
field.helpText: Enter the password to log into the database.

field.label: Classpath
field.helpText: Enter the path to the Jar file

field.label: Connection Properties
field.helpText: Enter any additional properties that need to be set on the initial context.

field.label: Get Operation Type
field.helpText: Choose the Get Operation Type for Get operation

field.label: Max Rows
field.helpText: Set the maximum number of rows to be returned from the Database in a single request.

field.label: Document Batching
field.helpText: The records retrieved from database are batched in the output.

field.label: Batch Count
field.helpText: The number of records retrieved per output document for document batching.
